fields.issue: The re-rank rows at 4 and 1 kg/m3 presume a structural core that does not exist today. MAINLINE-007 retrieved no catalog core with sourced shear modulus, compressive modulus and strength below 16 kg/m3 (Plascore lightest 16, ROHACELL IG-F starts 31, HexWeb lightest retrieved 24; Schaedler nickel microlattice 0.9 kg/m3 has no retrieved modulus or strength).
fields.consequence: Every light-core row in this card is PROJECTION on the core side regardless of face material. The wrinkling comparison on those rows uses Ec*Gc products belonging to 24-38 kg/m3 cores, which cannot ride on a 1-4 kg/m3 row at any thickness near the mass ceiling (a 32 kg/m3 core at the 1 kg/m3 row's 0.1884 m thickness would alone mass about 7576 kg against a 4889 kg ceiling).
fields.next: Source or project an ultra-light core with a stated Ec*Gc product and strength; until then the light-core readings measure the core gap, not a build.
